linkedin: Managing a large collection—whether books, vinyl, or DVDs—is a labour of love. But it comes with a real problem: duplicate purchases. How many times have you discovered you already own a title, tucked away on a shelf somewhere? At a record fair or charity shop, it happens. You're excited, you don't check, and suddenly you're out £5 for something you've owned for years. For collectors with 300+ items, this isn't just frustrating—it adds up. SeniorEase Library solves this with honest simplicity: scan a barcode, and the app tells you instantly if you already own it. One €4.99 payment. No subscription. No account. Your data stays on your device. It respects both your collection and your time—because collecting should bring joy, not regret. Learn more at seniorease.eu. #Collecting #DigitalTools #Simplicity
